module_summary: Serial byte-frame checker: 12-state FSM walks start bit, eight data-bit states and stop bit, pulsing done on valid stop or waiting in ERR.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Start/bit-position/stop/error controller register; implicitly counts the 8 data bits.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Asserted in DONE state after a correctly framed byte.

groups.name: Frame receiver FSM
groups.description: Sequences start, data, stop bits and error recovery on serial input.
